name: OMCS
summary: Gold Coast QLD / Northern Rivers dialup + ISDN + web hosting ISP (omcs.com.au live by 1997; 'fastest digital Internet provider from the Gold Coast to the Northern Rivers'); in the Nornet/Linear G group from ~2001; brand folded into LinearG c. 2009.

events.details: Gold Coast/Byron Bay/Coffs Harbour area dialup + ISDN + web hosting/marketing ISP; omcs.com.au homepage counter 'Visitors since 4th April 1997'.

refs.label: OMCS (Wayback 11 Nov 1998): 'Fastest Digital Internet Provider from the Gold Coast to the Northern Rivers', counter since 4 Apr 1997

events.details: Nornet's site states the Modulux/Nornet group had OMCS under its umbrella 'since 2001'; omcs.com.au kept operating until the domain began redirecting to nor.com.au.

refs.label: Nornet (Wayback 25 Jul 2013): 'Since 2001, Modulux pty ltd have under its umbrella, Gold Coast based OMCS Internet ...'

events.details: Brand folded into the group; omcs.com.au redirecting to nor.com.au by May 2009 (an earlier single 301 was archived 29 Aug 2008; Nornet itself folded into linearg.com Dec 2014).

refs.label: LinearG homepage: lists OMCS among the ISPs incorporated
